run_evaluate_masks: run evaluate_masks to evaluate instance segmentation results on the Cityscapes dataset
run_cityscapes_evaluation: run the Cityscapes instance-level semantic labeling evaluation using prediction masks and bounding boxes
run_segmentation_eval: run segmentation evaluation by writing prediction txt files and mask PNGs then invoking Cityscapes eval
review_evaluate_masks: review evaluate_masks to understand how it decodes RLE masks and writes prediction files for Cityscapes
summarize_evaluate_masks: summarize evaluate_masks which takes all_boxes and all_segms and runs the official Cityscapes evaluation script
